periods.time: Early summer break after Seven Stars

name.zh: 珠雫在广岛拜雾子为师
name.en: Shizuku Studies Under Kiriko in Hiroshima

periods.summary: Shizuku visits Kiriko Yakushi to learn healing magic after feeling useless when Ikki nearly died. Kiriko shows her work with terminal patients, agrees to teach her for free, but first diagnoses dangerous distortions in Shizuku's body caused by imperfect self-vaporization reconstruction. Shizuku refuses anesthesia so she can directly experience Kiriko's technique, and Kiriko begins a painful corrective operation.
periods.cause: Shizuku wants to become strong enough to save Ikki in future crises and seeks instruction from the White-Robed Knight.
periods.process: At the hospital Shizuku sees Kiriko's terminal ward where patients can live actively until death. In Kiriko's private lab she asks to learn healing arts. Kiriko detects bodily distortions by lightly touching Shizuku, explains the danger, locks the lab, and prepares surgery. Shizuku insists on remaining conscious despite extreme pain.
periods.outcome: Kiriko accepts Shizuku as a student-patient and begins treating her body, marking the start of Shizuku's healing path.
periods.significance: Develops Shizuku beyond combat water magic and links her growth to medical responsibility and Ikki's previous near-death.
